questions.question:
Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.

My grandmother said, "I bore six children."

options.text: My grandmother said that she has born six children.
My grandmother said she bore six children.
My grandmother said that she had borne six children.
My grandmother told that she had bore six children.

questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is Option 3.**
 
• The given sentence is in the past indefinite tense. When changing from direct to indirect, past indefinite tense changes to the past perfect tense. The structure of the past indefinite tense is **'subject + had + v3'.**
 
• Therefore, the structure is correctly followed by option 3 'My grandmother said that she had borne six children.'

Here, verb Bear means 'to give birth' and 'bore' and 'borne' are its 'past' and 'past particle' forms respectively.

questions.question:
Identify the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment. If no substitution is required, select No substitution.

The shoebill stork can be __recognise from its__ long legs and broad wings.
questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is Option 3.**
 
• The rule is that 'can be' is always followed by V3. Therefore, 'recognise' should be replaced by 'recognised'.
 
• The correct preposition to be used n the given sentence is 'by' which is used to indicate the person that does something in a passive voice sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence is 'The shoebill stork can be recognised by its long legs and broad wings.'

questions.question:
**Identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.**

Each of the pictures have been signed by the football star.
questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is Option 4.**
 
• The error lies in the wrong usage of the subject-verb agreement.
 
• Here, the verb 'have' is followed by the subject 'each' & not 'pictures'. The subject 'each' is singular, the verb should also be singular. So, replace 'have' by 'has'.
 
• **Therefore, the correct sentence is 'Each of the pictures has been signed by the football star.'**

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. Her father had been stuck in an elevator for six hours.

B. Esha had heard from her parents about a blackout caused by a sudden storm.

C. She had to grope in the dark and cook by the candlelight.

D. Her mother's story had been quite different from his.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** option 2) i.e. BADC.**

 
• The only **independent **sentence from the given sentences is the sentence 'B'. Hence, it will be the **first **sentence.
 
• Sentence 'D' cannot follow the sentence 'B' because in the sentence 'D' the pronoun **'his'** has been used.
 
• '**HIs**' has been used for the noun **'father'** which is used in the sentence 'A'. 
 
• Hence, sentence 'D' will follow the sentence 'A'. So, the correct sequence is **'BAD'.**
 
• So, the correct sequence is **'BADC'**.

questions.question:
Identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.

It was a windy autumn day and leaves were fallen rapidly from the trees.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e. leaves were fallen.**

 
• The given sentence is in the **active** voice, hence,** 'were+v3' cannot** be used in this sentence.
 
• So, we will use '**were+v1+ing**' which makes the sentence in **continuous **form. 
 
• The process of falling of leaves is a **continuous process**, hence, past continuous tense will be used in the given sentence.
 
• So, the correct sentence will be: **It was a windy autumn day and leaves were falling rapidly from the trees.**

Let A have x rupees, and C have y rupees.

A takes 12 rupees from C

now A have total amount =

x + 12 …..(i)

and

y - 12

A has an equal amount as B has,

A = B

A + B = 102

From equation 2

x + 12 + x = 102

2x + 12 = 102

2x = 102 – 12

X = 45

Hence, A has total amount of 45 rupees.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

211 × 14 + 627 ÷ 33 – 17 = 520
questions.solution:
211 × 14 + 627 ÷ 33 – 17 = 520

Option 1: (+ and ÷)

211 × 14 ÷ 627 + 33 – 17

By solving according to BODMAS

4,71 + 33 - 17 ≠ 520

 

Option 2: ( ÷ and × )

211 ÷ 14 + 627 × 33 – 17 

By solving according to BODMAS

15.071 + 627 × 33 -17

15.071 + 20691 - 17 ≠ 520

 

Option 3: (+ and - )

211 × 14 - 627 ÷ 33 + 17 

By solving according to BODMAS

211 × 14 - 19 + 17

2954 - 2 ≠ 520

 

**Option 4: ( × and - )**

**211 – 14 + 627 ÷ 33 × 17**

**By solving according to BODMAS**

**211 – 14 + 19 × 17**

**211 – 14 + 323**

**211 + 323 – 14**

**534 – 14 =520**

Hence, the changing × by - will make the equation correct

questions.question: If a 10-digit number 1230x558y2 is divisible by 88, then the value of (5x + 5y) is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

If a number is divisible by 88 then it must be divisible by 8 × 11

When a number is divisible by 88 then its last three digits are also divisible by 8

∴ 8y2 is divisible by y when y = 3

When a number is divisible by 11 then difference of its sum of the alternate numbers will be zero or multiple of 11

The number 1230x558y2 = 1230x55832 will be divisible by zero

When

(1 + 3 + x + 5 + 3) - (2 + 0 + 5 + 8 + 2) = 0 or multiple of 11

⇒ (12 + x) – (17) = 0 or 11

∴ Possible value of x = 5

Now

**5x + 5y = 5 × 5 + 5 × 3 = 25 + 15 = 40**

questions.question: If cos x = -1/2 and π < x < 3π/2, then the value of 2 tan²x + 3 cosec²x is:
questions.solution:
Calculation:

cos x = -1/2 = cos 240°

∴ x = 240°

2tan²x + 3cosec²x = 2tan²240° + 3cosec²240° = 2tan²(180° + 60°) + 3cosec²(180° + 60°)

A, B, and C can complete a piece of work in 4, 20, and 60 days respectively. Working together, they can complete one-third of the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Time is taken by A to complete the work = 4 days

Time is taken by B to complete the work = 20 days

Time is taken by C to complete the work = 60 days

Total work = (LCM of 4, 20, and 60) = 60 units

The efficiency of A in 1 day = 60/4 = 15

The efficiency of B in 1 day = 60/20 = 3

The efficiency of C in 1 day = 60/60 = 1

1/3 of total work = 60 × 1/3 = 20

Efficiency of A, B and C together = 15 + 3 + 1 = 19

**Together they can complete one-third of the same work = 20/19 = 1(1)/({19)} days**

questions.question: If x% of y is 150 and y% of z is 300, then the relation between x and z is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divide the two given conditions to directly eliminate the common term 'y':

(y% of z) ÷ (x% of y) = 300 ÷ 150

⇒ (y × z) ÷ (x × y) = 2

⇒ z ÷ x = 2 ⇒ z = 2x

**∴ The correct answer is z = 2x.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x% of y = 150

y% of z = 300

**Formula Used:**

a% of b = (a × b) ÷ 100

 
 x% of y = 150 xy = 15000 y% of z = 300 yz = 30000 
 Divide z ÷ x = 30000 ÷ 15000 = 2 

**Calculations:**

⇒ x% of y = 150

⇒ (x ÷ 100) × y = 150

⇒ xy = 15000 ... (1)

⇒ y% of z = 300

⇒ (y ÷ 100) × z = 300

⇒ yz = 30000 ... (2)

⇒ Dividing Equation (2) by Equation (1):

⇒ (yz) ÷ (xy) = 30000 ÷ 15000

⇒ z ÷ x = 2

⇒ z = 2x

**∴ The correct answer is z = 2x.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Interchangeability of Percentages

An important fundamental property of percentages is that a% of b is mathematically identical to b% of a. Both evaluate directly to (a × b) ÷ 100.

Ratio Comparison Method

When solving algebraic equations with multiple variables where one variable acts as a common link (such as 'y' in xy and yz), dividing the two equations yields the most direct ratio of the remaining isolated variables.

Percentage Change Rule

To calculate the net percentage by which a base quantity A is more or less than B, always apply the base formula: [(A − B) ÷ B] × 100.

The correct answer is option 2 i.e __**19.50%**__

**Statutory Liquidity Ratio:** 

 
• The share of NDTL that a bank is required to maintain in safe and liquid assets, such as unencumbered government securities, cash, and gold.
 
• Changes in SLR often influence the availability of resources in the banking system for lending to the private sector.
 
• The SLR is determined as a percentage of total demand and time liabilities.
 
• RBI used SLR to control inflation and fuel growth, by decreasing or increasing the money supply.

**How SLR is used to control Inflation**

 
• If RBI increases the SLR Rate then the bank has to hold more money, so the lending capacity of the bank decreases and the flow of money in the market decreases which means people have less money to spend which means demand decreases and hence inflation decreases.
 
• IF RBI decreases the SLR Rate then the bank has to hold less money. So the lending capacity of the bank increases and the flow of money in the market increases which means people have more money to spend and hence demand increases and hence inflation increases.
